name: zdi_rebuild_generated_uv_pairs_for_entry
description: zDi::RebuildGeneratedUvPairsForEntry regenerates generated UV pairs for vertices beyond the first triangle using the dominant-axis planar projection.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers the generated-UV interpolation path for the Z-dominant XY projection. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4843b0 validates the fastcall ABI with self in ecx and entryIndex in edx, indexing zDiEntryPartial entries by 0x1c-byte stride.

Binary Ninja assembly validates skipping when material flag 0x0100 is not set or the entry has three or fewer vertices, computing the first-triangle normal, selecting the dominant normal axis, solving U and V scalar gradients with zModel_Const::SolveTriScalarGradient2D, and regenerating uvPairs for vertex indices 3..n-1.
The native smoke verifies a generated-UV four-vertex square in the Z-dominant XY projection rewrites the fourth UV from the first triangle's planar mapping.
